Subject: Re: Implementation plan and capacity alignment

Thanks Karthik — we reviewed the draft order form and SOW with our infra team. Two asks before we can sign: (1) shift 40% of the initial GPU commitment to a burst SKU for the first 90 days (we expect a spike during pilot), and (2) clarify billing proration for partial-month top-ups. Can your team provide an amended order form and redline the SOW to reflect the burst SKU and an implementation schedule that allows a soft cutover?

Also attaching a short operations note with the pilot window constraints. Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

—Elena
BrightMesh, Head of Platform

Team — billing/proration details: our billing engine can prorate at the SKU-line level. For partial-month top-ups we compute a pro-rata factor based on the number of active days the SKU was provisioned in the invoice period and apply that to the unit price. Recommended approach for clarity: (1) add a distinct "Burst (90d)" SKU line in the order form CSV, (2) include a clause in OrderForm terms: "Burst SKUs will be billed pro-rata starting on the activation date; any usage beyond committed units will be charged at the overage rate specified for that SKU."

I attached an export template showing how the burst line will appear. Jonas — please review the proposed clause and confirm if any legal caveats are needed (audit, overage dispute window).

Laura
Revenue Ops, Redwood Inference

Attachments: OrderForm_SKUs_v3.csv (billing export template)

Date: 2027-08-21T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Implementation plan and capacity alignment

All — reviewed the SOW redlines and order form changes. Draft guidance and suggested wording below (summarized):

1) Addendum / Change Order language: "This Addendum updates the Order Form dated [Execution Date] to (i) add a temporary Burst SKU for a 90-day pilot window effective on activation, and (ii) update the implementation timeline to permit a soft cutover per the Implementation Schedule. All other terms remain in full force."

2) Proration clause for Order Form: "Billing for Burst SKUs will be pro-rated on a per-SKU, per-invoice-period basis from activation date to the end of the invoice period. Any overage incurred while a Burst SKU is active will be charged at the published overage rate for that SKU. Customer dispute window for billing related to Burst usage: 45 days from invoice date."

3) Audit & data retention: add a short sentence giving both parties 60 days to request usage logs tied to burst charges for reconciliation.

I've attached a redlined SOW (BrightMesh_SOW_v2_redlines.docx) with inline edits and a separate proposed Addendum template. Laura — the proration wording above should slot into the Order Form terms; if this looks good I'll prepare the final Addendum and send to Elena for signature (DocuSign link).

Jonas
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachments: BrightMesh_SOW_v2_redlines.docx; Addendum_Template_BurstSKU.docx
